name: project-delphi-rubric
description: Weighted 0-100 evaluation rubric scored independently by two cross-provider frontier models.

dimensions.question: Does the code implement the exact mathematical equation as stated in the paper?
Does the fitted curve match the full empirical domain (not just a cherry-picked subset)?
Are the fitted parameters physically interpretable and tested on synthetic recovery?
Are residuals (RMSE, R^2) reported and verified by the independent sidecar?
Is the empirical dataset pinned by SHA-256 and verified before execution?
Do code comments map variables directly to the Lean 4 law and paper equation?
Is the script deterministic with a passing self-test?
